description: External data sources are NOT silently added to the frozen v0.1 eight-task benchmark.

candidates.independence: different original study / lab from 2026 GrimACE; 8 animal IDs, image frames within animals correlated
candidates.leakage: source has bounding boxes; image should not include label, subject ID, or intervention metadata
candidates.evaluation: External animal-disjoint orbital tightening; not equivalent to five-AU GrimACE composite.
blockers: confirm exact source pixels and image-to-record match
verify dataset license and permitted redistribution/commercial model training
ensure exposure/annotation provenance and proper task equivalence

candidates.target: independently instrumented mechanical nociceptive threshold and recorded wound healing
blockers: Original Dryad individual-file and public dataset API returned HTTP 403 to automation
need authorized or human-mediated original downloads with checksum verification
choose forward-only wound history vs later MNT; avoid using current/future nociceptive target as input
check 48 animal IDs and longitudinal split / publication license

candidates.target: original pre-hospital or hospital veterinary priority, multi-rater and independent clinic outcomes
minimum_requirements: unique cases not derivatives of Wong/Farrow or the same 30 vignette variants
at least two independent expert urgencies with timestamp/origin metadata
exclude later diagnostic confirmation from model-visible owner presentation
independent critical cases and prospective outcomes preferred
data license and clinical de-identification approval
blockers: no suitable independently expert-rated open case-level source yet verified
requires data owner collaboration or another genuine new original corpus
